name: SR-18
summary: RCS-8 (also known as 1-(2-cyclohexylethyl)-3-(2-methoxyphenylacetyl)indole, SR-18, and BTM-8) is a synthetic cannabinoid that has been found as an ingredient of "herbal smoking blends". It can be described as an analogue of JWH-250 with the 1-pentyl group replaced by 1-(2-cyclohexylethyl), and can be expected to be less potent than JWH-250.

pharmacology.text: All CB1 receptor agonists of the 3-phenylacetylindole class such as RCS-8 are Schedule I Controlled Substances within the United States.

uses.en: It has been found as an ingredient in herbal smoking blends sold as legal highs. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它曾在以合法興奮劑名義販售的草本吸食混合物中被驗出，沒有任何醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它曾在以合法兴奋剂名义贩售的草本吸食混合物中被验出，没有任何医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, anxiety and panic, vomiting, confusion, psychosis and seizures, and some have caused deaths.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。其所屬的合成大麻素類藥物可能造成心跳加速、焦慮與恐慌、嘔吐、意識混亂、精神病症狀與癲癇發作，部分已造成死亡。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。其所属的合成大麻素类药物可能造成心跳加速、焦虑与恐慌、呕吐、意识混乱、精神病症状与癫痫发作，部分已造成死亡。

fact.en: It is an analogue of the synthetic cannabinoid JWH-250 in which the pentyl tail has been swapped for a cyclohexylethyl group.
fact.zh: 它是合成大麻素JWH-250的類似物，把原本的戊基尾鏈換成了環己基乙基。
fact.zhHans: 它是合成大麻素JWH-250的类似物，把原本的戊基尾链换成了环己基乙基。
